page.layout: One printed page, rotated 90 degrees. A single diagram (outline with braces and brackets) fills the page. No running head, page number or catchword.

main_text.l: A primo ortus, qui etiam vel

page.notes: The page is printed sideways; the diagram is transcribed in the order of its boxes, with levels read from the braces. The faint running head at the top is too damaged to read and is omitted. Some words in the braces are partly faded; "Connexum" and "Diuersitas" are read with some doubt. The first line "Simplicem, qui est vel" carries a printed comma after "Simplicem". Brace and bracket marks are not text.
